periods.summary: Ikki begins the volume as Hagun's F-rank repeat student and alleged Worst One. After an accidental first meeting with Stella, he defeats her in a duel by using Ittou Shura. He reconnects with Shizuku, helps resolve a Rebellion hostage crisis, then overcomes trauma and Kirihara's invisible attacks in his first official selection battle. Stella's public defense restores his spirit, and he ends the volume by confessing to her and promising to meet her in the Seven Stars final.

periods.summary: Ikki extends his selection streak by defeating Renren Tomaru and later Ayase. He helps Ayase improve her swordsmanship, then is betrayed when she forces him to spend Ittou Shura before their match. Rather than cut her off, he asks Oreki to let the match continue, defeats her with minimum harm, and restores her dignity. He then challenges Kuraudo for the Ayatsuji dojo. By reading and enduring Kuraudo's Sword Eater style, he identifies Marginal Counter and wins with Ten'i Muhou, a copied Ayatsuji ultimate technique. Meanwhile he and Stella finally break through their romantic awkwardness with a first kiss.

periods.summary: Ikki enters vol-03 as an undefeated selection contender and as Stella's secret boyfriend. After the scandal is engineered by Akaza and the Kurogane side, he is confined by the Ethics Committee, denied proper rest and water, drugged, and interrogated for weeks. A meeting with his father Itsuki shatters his belief that his family bond might one day be repaired, leaving him physically and psychologically broken. He nevertheless accepts a duel against Toka Todo when Akaza frames the matter as the only way to protect his knight status and Stella's father's opinion. On the final day he nearly collapses before reaching Hagun, but Shizuku, Stella, and many students' cheers remind him that he now carries others' expectations. In the match he challenges Toka's strongest technique head-on, compresses Ittou Shura into the one-instant Ittou Rasetsu, shatters Narukami, and earns the title Another One. Immediately after the victory he asks Stella to become his family before collapsing from the backlash.

key_events.summary: Akaza uses the couple's kiss photo and fabricated allegations to summon Ikki.
Itsuki tells Ikki to abandon knighthood because his success disrupts hierarchy.
Ikki reaches Hagun while gravely ill and accepts the support of students and allies.
Ikki defeats Toka with Ittou Rasetsu and becomes a representative.
He asks Stella to become his family before losing consciousness.

periods.summary: Ikki dominates the Yamagata joint training camp enough that Hagun must call Nango as a special coach, and he informally coaches the Hagure sisters. He and Stella meet Amane after stopping a random killer, but Ikki feels a disturbing omen around the friendly boy. During Akatsuki's attack he accepts Alice's defection plan, then realizes Amane has used foresight to counter it. He follows Shizuku to rescue Alice and confronts Edelweiss at Akatsuki's base. Although utterly outclassed, he fights with Ittou Shura, Perfect Vision and his secret swords, persists after Intetsu is shattered, wins Edelweiss's recognition as a swordsman, and even draws a few drops of her blood. Afterward he chooses to enter Seven Stars despite the state-backed Akatsuki plot and is bracketed against reigning champion Yuudai Moroboshi in round one.

periods.summary: Ikki arrives in Osaka as Hagun's captain and immediately attracts national attention as the F-rank who defeated Raikiri. At the banquet he protects Shizuku from Yui Tatara's poison trap and earns recognition from Yuudai Moroboshi. Moroboshi later invites him to the family okonomiyaki shop so that Ikki will enter their match in peak condition. Ouma confronts Ikki that night, denounces his strength as trickery, and wounds him; Ikki discovers that his body freezes at decisive moments. In the first-round duel against Moroboshi he is repeatedly caught by Moroboshi's tactics and by that unexplained paralysis. Near defeat, he recalls and synchronizes with the movement pattern copied from Edelweiss: instantaneous zero-to-max acceleration. With this awakened sword movement plus Ittou Shura and Shinkirou, he defeats Moroboshi and advances to round two.

periods.summary: Ikki returns from medical treatment in time to watch Stella finish her B-block battle and concludes her revealed Brute Dragon Roar is not the true fruit of Nene's training. He then confronts Amane Shinomiya, deduces that Amane is not predicting futures but causing wished-for outcomes through overwhelming luck/causality, and firmly rejects Amane's offer to hand him the Seven Stars championship. At night he tries to reconnect with Stella, flees Sara's intrusive demand to paint him nude, and takes refuge in Ouma's room, where he learns Ouma's cooperation with Akatsuki is tied to Itsuki and to drawing out Stella's potential. On the compressed second-round day Ikki reassures Stella, watches Kurando's evolved swordsmanship and Sara's copy of himself with alarm, then begins his match against Byakuya by immediately using Ittou Rasetsu rather than playing into Byakuya's twenty-three-move prediction.

periods.summary: Vol-08 frames Ikki through side episodes and an origin story. After defeating Kirihara, he demonstrates sword techniques to classmates and reveals he has memorized 126 sword styles, including Stella's Imperial Arts. His kindness toward classmates and care for Shizuku motivate both Stella's attraction and Shizuku's jealousy. During the poltergeist incident he teams with Kanata, trusts her Diamond Dust support, captures a telekinetic monkey and learns Kanata's noblesse-oblige creed. The final Episode0 reveals his entrance exam: he challenged Yuri Oreki because he knew she was the strongest present, copied and evolved her sword style, endured Violet Pain, used Ittou Shura and a blade-stealing counter, and won admission while refusing to abandon the knight's path despite Oreki's warning.

periods.summary: Ikki opens the volume by defeating former finalist Byakuya in a record 0.8 seconds with Ittou Rasetsu, but privately recognizes the win as costly because it spends his daily trump card before the Sara match. In the infirmary he recovers, jokes with Stella, meets his father Itsuki, and is stunned when Itsuki proposes severing their parent-child relationship for the Kurogane family's order. During the shopping interlude Ikki helps handle Sara's clothing problem, rescues a teleporting infant with Stella and Sara, and hears Sara's history with her father's unfinished painting. Her statement that one-sided love of a parent is still valid gives Ikki the answer he needed: he refuses to cut ties with Itsuki and tells him to remain his father despite their opposing paths. In the third round Ikki faces Sara without Ittou Shura, dismantles her necro battalion with footwork, exposes the limits of her copied Edelweiss, then uses a one-sword first-strike advantage and even his skull as a timing shield to cut the phantom. He finally defeats Sara's true soul-image, Mario Rosso, by luring it into Edelweiss's residual vacuum cuts and stabbing Sara while holding Intetsu in his teeth. He reaches the semifinals, only to witness Shizuku's bloody defeat by Amane on the waiting-room feed.

periods.summary: Ikki trains overnight by cutting wood and iron with paper to refine Edelweiss-style energy control, preparing for Amane while Stella encourages him. Bakuya Tsukikage reveals Amane's original identity and life story, enabling Ikki to understand the hatred he senses. After Stella defeats Ouma, Ikki visits Shizuku and Alice, thanks Shizuku for fighting, and declares that only Amane cannot beat him. During the semifinal, he refuses to chase Amane if he withdraws, then provokes him by exposing his self-pity. In battle he faces luck-amplified sword strikes and ricocheting Azure blades, but uses clothing to catch the blades and embodied sword mastery to recover from every forced mistake. When Amane stops his heart, Ikki restarts it manually and cuts him down without using Ittou Shura. After Amane's post-defeat rampage, Ikki activates Ittou Shura anyway to save the venue and, more importantly, to give Amane a reason not to abandon himself. He defeats Amane's final self-made sword motion with the second secret sword Rekkou. Although a death result has grazed him, he initially seems fine, then collapses in the preparation room. Kiriko saves him, but he wakes a day late, believing he missed the final; Stella and the committee reveal everyone waited and Kaieda reschedules the final for the following night.

periods.summary: Ikki wakes from near death just in time for the delayed championship. Afraid of Stella's awakened dragon power, he requests a gauntlet of strong sparring partners and converts fear into peak readiness. In the final he first suppresses Stella with prediction, Madoka and close-range pressure, but Dragon Spirit and the lava field force him into a soul clash. He exhausts Ittou Shura and seems to lose to Stella's finishing blow, yet rejects a respectable defeat inside a vision of fate's chains. His love for Stella and desire to remain her strongest break those chains, raising his magic beyond its fixed limit. He returns at nine, uses Ittou Rasetsu and the final secret sword Oikage to defeat Stella, becomes Seven Stars Sword King, and later stands beside her on the podium after their relationship deepens in the infirmary.

key_events.summary: Uses allies and rivals to sharpen his body and confidence before facing Stella.
Breaks fate's chains, awakens new magic, creates Oikage, and wins the final.

Receives the Seven Stars Sword King title and raises Hagun's flag.

periods.summary: Ikki celebrates his Seven Stars victory in Osaka, then meets Tsukikage at the Bay Dome and learns that using a second Ittou Shura against Stella was a Desperado awakening. He accepts the need to keep the truth secret while rejecting Tsukikage's help until Tsukikage explains the future war he foresaw. During his trip to Vermillion, Ikki is attacked by citizens, soldiers, young C-rank knights, royal guards, and Daniel Dandalion because the nation wants to test the man who would take Stella. Instead of resenting them, he concludes that their hostility comes from love for Stella. He publicly asks Stella's family to test him and pledges to meet any demand, then accepts Lunaeyes's condition that he fight for Vermillion in the war against Quedolan.

key_events.summary: Fights Ascaride with Stella and learns he has entered the Desperado realm.

periods.summary: Ikki endures Sirius Vermillion's comic but serious acceptance tests, defeating him instantly in simulated combat, arm wrestling, and a marathon errand. He accepts Lunaeyes' request to train Timid and Milialia, then visits Quedland with Stella and Lunaeyes. During Or-Gaule's ambush, Ikki alone reacts fast enough to intercept Killing Opera with Ittou Rasetsu, saving the crowd at the cost of massive wounds and exhaustion. After Alice Ascaride evacuates and heals him, Ikki proposes the Caldia plan: he will act as Vermillion's aerial eyes, read the puppet-command wave patterns from a helicopter, and have Milialia mark relay nodes. He performs this role successfully until B.B. destroys the helicopter. Despite no magic and broken bones, Ikki blinds B.B. and deliberately lures the giant away from unconscious soldiers, nearly dying before Alice arrives.

periods.summary: During Vermillion's noisy funeral wake, Ikki speaks with Sirius about the country's tradition of smiling for the dead. When Sirius confronts him about stopping Edelweiss from saving Stella, Ikki admits the facts and explains that he could not rob Stella of the struggle she chose as the Crimson Princess. Sirius cannot accept the reasoning as a father, but tells Ikki that the earlier promise remains: if Ikki wants Stella, he must make Sirius acknowledge him with his sword. Later, Stella fears Ikki may die in a real war and asks whether he truly must participate. Ikki answers that Stella's homeland and family are reason enough, embraces her, and vows not to lose or die because her side is where he belongs. At the opening of the representative war, Naseem's sandstorm throws him high into the air. Ikki survives the fall by using his uniform jacket as an improvised parachute and B.B.'s slap-wind to cancel momentum, then faces the giant child. He first tries intimidation and persuasion, but when B.B. declares he fights for Or-Gaule as a friend, Ikki accepts him as a man with conviction. Ikki exploits the gaps and slow tracking caused by B.B.'s enormous size, severs the Achilles and knee tendons, finishes with Rhino Strike to the temple, and comforts the unconscious child before handing him to medics.

periods.summary: On the night before battle, Yui Tatara confronts Ikki outside his room, tests his readiness with a sudden attack, and asks him to help kill Alice before the war. She argues that Alice's hatred of Or-Gaule is based on responsibility and guilt rather than genuine killing intent, making her an unstable ally. Ikki refuses assassination because he saw Alice's courage and fear in Quedland and wants to trust that part of her, but he accepts that if Yui's fear proves true he must bear responsibility. When Alice later protects Or-Gaule and turns on Stella, Ikki appears and sends Stella after the airborne Or-Gaule. Facing Alice alone, he does not condemn her with easy morality; instead, he states that choosing the unforgivable path while knowing its consequences is her own chivalry. He declares that his weakest blade will block that chivalry, allowing Alice to stand as an equal enemy. Her full sword aura approaches the pressure he once felt from Edelweiss, but Ikki remains calm, proof of his growth, and the duel begins.

key_events.summary: Rejects Yui's assassination plan but accepts responsibility if Alice betrays them.

periods.summary: Ikki first appears apparently dying after Or-Gaule's final attack, then the volume reveals how that moment was reached. He takes over the fight against Alice Ascaride so Stella can pursue Or-Gaule. Against Alice's Invincible Armor and Regeneration Overdose, he initially cannot damage her, but he reads both her fighting patterns and her need to save Or-Gaule. By trusting Stella to corner Or-Gaule, he forces Alice to abandon the safe long battle and accept a short decisive clash. Using Ittou Rasetsu and the final secret sword Oikage, he cuts through Invincible Armor, defeats Alice, and holds her as she dies, promising never to forget the gentle knight who fought for family. The battle earns him the new name Sword God. After briefly recovering via autophagy, Ikki intervenes when Or-Gaule's corpse uses Danse Macabre to strangle Stella. Ikki duels the undead Or-Gaule for one minute with no magic and a collapsing body, publicly declares that he will die to buy Stella the chance to recover, and secretly plants delayed Kuruizakura cuts. Or-Gaule tears open his chest and kills him, but those cuts later disrupt La Grand Guignol, allowing Stella to burn Or-Gaule to ash. Shizuku then uses Water World to rebuild Ikki from cells and temporarily replaces missing tissue with her own. Ikki awakens in hospital three days later in a child-sized body, learns of Shizuku's promotion and his own new political weight, and reconciles with Stella after accepting that planning to die was a betrayal of their love.

periods.summary: Ikki survives the Or-Gaule conflict only because Shizuku arrives under League summons and heals him after he briefly dies. The damage cannot be fully restored immediately: his body shrinks to roughly a ten-year-old's size and his strength, stamina, reach and skin durability drop accordingly. Rather than despairing, Ikki treats the setback as a training opportunity and resolves to refine technique beyond the limits of his old physique, aiming to fight effectively in the temporary child body and eventually surpass his former self.

periods.summary: Ikki returns from Vermillion in a temporary child-sized body sustained by Shizuku. In Tokyo Bay he combines his sword skill with Shizuku's water magic, reproducing Ryoma Kurogane's ice swordsmanship, then separates to board and disable a US carrier despite his small frame and limited strength. On victory night he becomes lost in the crowd, is mistaken for an injured child by Ayase, and is dragged into a women's bath until Toka recognizes and covers for him. After Stella scolds him, the two bathe together and later speak on a quiet hill about marriage, children and their future. Arlanz's Abraham clone ambushes them; Ikki kills the clone's head and heart but cannot overcome its Magic Creature body before it self-destructs, leaving him near death as Stella is taken.

periods.summary: After awakening from near-fatal injuries, Ikki learns Karl Eilands abducted Stella and joins Shizuku, Ouma, Touka and Alice in a sanctioned rescue. In Eilands' underground lab he fights alongside Shizuku, defeats Darwin's monstrous body by accepting severe wounds and using a water-double trap, then battles Eilands' Perfect Fortune imitation of his future swordsmanship. He and Shizuku defeat that body, but Eilands has already infiltrated Stella and uses her to stab Ikki. When Eilands tries to kill Shizuku with Stella's body, Ikki nearly sacrifices all future through Excessive Awakening before Edelweiss, Ouma and Shizuku restore his resolve. Shizuku fuses him into Stella's body; in Stella's mind, Ikki realizes their bond began in mutual admiration and attacks her with Tsuikage, trusting she will answer as his greatest rival. Stella awakens and expels Eilands. By October Ikki recovers, receives recommendations for KOK A-class, reflects on his journey from Worst One to acknowledged knight, and travels to Vermillion for his wedding with Stella.
